answer: Delay-sequencing bond: each identity locks 60 credits and takes one marble step on the terrace. Each epoch a zephyr beacon seeds a sequential delay chain each identity must run — one machine, one chain per epoch. Auditors replay each chain; a missing or reused step burns it. One chain costs 55 credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 55,000 plus 60,000 locked against a 40,000 pool; rented-chain rings pay 55 each. An honest agent pays 55 once, keeps its bond.
